name: bloggroup-create
description: A blog group creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create and publish a new blog group under a specified site language, with support for group name, tags, and brief description.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

bloggroup.description: Required. Complete blog group payload for the new published blog group.

group_name.description: Required. Blog group name, up to 100 characters.

tags.description: Required. Provide 1 to 6 keyword tags. Each tag must be 50 characters or fewer.

brief_description.description: Optional. Short plain-text description, up to 300 characters.

seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for search engines.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact blog group creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact blog group payload to be created. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact blog group payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the created blog group page. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.
